RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT PROJECT STATUS REPORT

PROJECT NO.: B-465

PROJECT NAME: ADDITIVES FOR REDUCED SIDESTREAM PAPER - RSP

PROJECT DESCRIPTION:

The principle objective of the project is to evaluate the ability of chemical additives to improve the aroma of reduced sidestream cigarettes. The Organic Section will acquire or modify a number of candidate additives to be incorporated into the paper either alone or as carbohydrate glucosides. Product Development will prepare and evaluate reduced sidestream cigarettes made from these papers.
